objective: Consume published actual F08 proper electron density endpoints through exact BASS cold-Thomson normal-clock visibility modules without chemistry or solver changes.
composition_semantics: ElectronState(ne_m3,0,1,0,0) is an explicitly auxiliary density container for exported aggregate ne; it does not reconstruct or assert hydrogen-only composition.
input: All six actual F08 T0/T1/T2 BI/FLRW endpoint proper ne in cm^-3, normal seconds, D=1; finite ordered endpoint arrays with immutable SHA256 source manifest.
cell_surrogate: Piecewise constant qbar_i=(q_i+q_(i+1))/2 has the same cell integral as piecewise-linear interpolation of endpoint q. Endpoint survival agrees with that interpolation; cell probability is exact for its integrated depth. No within-cell visibility profile claim.

validation.oracle: Python Decimal precision 70 independent summation/exponentials from exact binary64 inputs and independent expression c*sigma_T*ne
checks: tail diagnostic scales survival and probabilities by exp(-0.1)

outputs: native endpoint CSV.gz per history with t/ne/q/tau/survival/cell probability
excluded_claims: directional Bianchi observable at fixed redshift
input_acquisition_update: All six exact files became available before native execution; original science/acceptance unchanged.
